note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); original in English, all three castes available (alate based on syntypes); the generic diagnosis is not translated; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier left mandible strongly twisted and widened at midlength, apex blunt and without a beak; right mandible shorter, blade-like. Postmentum long, club-shaped, waist strongly constricted, narrowest near the posterior margin. Alate forewing length 8.0–8.5 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish yellow; antennae pale brown; labrum translucent to pale yellow; left mandible dark brown, right mandible reddish black; body milky white. Head moderately pilose, body densely pilose. Body length about 4.0–5.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel (length to mandibular base 1.5–1.70 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.98 mm, width/length ratio 0.54–0.58); with coronal suture only, extending from the posterior margin to about half the head length. Fontanelle minute, at the base of the frontal slope (distance from fontanelle to posterior margin of head 1.10–1.33 mm, ratio of fontanelle distance to head length to mandibular base 0.71–0.76). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 4 shortest; segment 3 nearly as long as segment 2. Clypeus not distinctly divided into anteclypeus and postclypeus. Labrum strongly inflated and asymmetrical; surface with several short setae; anterior margin slightly incurved (length 0.25–0.325 mm, width 0.35–0.40 mm). Mandibles asymmetrical; left mandible strongly twisted and widened at midlength, apex blunt, without a beak (length 1.0–1.15 mm); right mandible shorter, blade-like, inner margin incurved at the apical third (length 0.90–1.00 mm). Postmentum long, club-shaped; waist strongly constricted, minimum width near the posterior margin (length 0.88–1.08 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, minimum width 0.125–0.15 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins without incisions (length 0.25–0.30 mm, width 0.55–0.57 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow; antennae, legs and thorax milky white; abdominal tergites and sternites transparent, grey gut contents visible through them. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.40–3.50 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long to mandibular base (length to mandibular base 0.63–0.65 mm, maximum width 0.73–0.78 mm). Fontanellar plate relatively large, translucent, diameter 0.09–0.10 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus concolorous with head, inflated and pilose; length nearly half its width (length 0.17–0.18 mm, width 0.375–0.40 mm). Labrum dome-shaped (length 0.25–0.27 mm, width 0.30 mm). Mandibles each with one large apical tooth and two marginal teeth. Left mandible with posterior margin of marginal tooth 1 long, marginal tooth 2 much reduced. Right mandible with posterior margin of marginal tooth 1 slightly longer than its anterior margin; posterior margin of marginal tooth 2 strongly incurved. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin without incision (length 0.18 mm, width 0.38–0.40 mm).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown; postclypeus, antennae, labrum and legs yellowish brown; pronotum and dorsal abdomen slightly paler than head, ventral abdomen yellowish brown; wings pale translucent brown. Head and body densely covered with fine short hairs and with several longer setae; wings pilose along the margins, membrane with a few short hairs. Body length with wings about 9.5–10.0 mm, without wings 5.0–6.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 1.00–1.03 mm, length to mandibular base 0.65 mm, maximum width including compound eyes 0.90–0.95 mm). Fontanelle small, dot-like, translucent. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Compound eyes markedly protruding, large, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.28–0.30 mm), close to the lower margin of the head (0.03 mm). Ocelli large, elliptical (length 0.11–0.13 mm, width 0.08 mm); separated from compound eye by nearly half their width (0.03–0.04 mm) and from antenna by about half their length (0.05–0.06 mm). Postclypeus inflated, pilose to the same degree as head; length about half its width (length 0.18–0.225 mm, width 0.43–0.45 mm). Pronotum semicircular; anterior margin slightly incurved with a weak median notch; posterior margin slightly incurved at the middle (length 0.47 mm, width 0.65–0.67 mm). Wings with minute spines; forewing length 8.0–8.5 mm.
